pool.text: European colonist Juan Rodríguez Cabrillo toured the coastline of the area.
Sebastián Vizcaíno mapped the coastline of the area toured by Europeans.
Juan Crespí documented more details about the area later called a valley.
Santiago Argüello Moraga established a rancho on his Mexican land grant.
Mexico lost Alta California as a result of a war.
Descendants of Santiago Argüello and Augustín Olvera agreed to develop the city.
The Agua Caliente Touristic Complex opened with a hotel and casino.
President Cárdenas decreed an end to gambling and casinos in Baja California.
The complex was reopened as a junior high school.
Javier Batiz founded a musical group called Los TJ's.
The Mexican federal government launched the Border Industrialization Program.
Work began on the first concrete channeling of the Tijuana River.
The PAN began to dominate the city politically after years of PRI dominance.
PRI presidential candidate Luis Donaldo Colosio was assassinated in Tijuana.
The Tijuana Youth Symphony was promoted to develop youth culture.
Tijuana earned international acclaim for an art exhibition on cement river banks.
Tijuana underwent a major overhaul of its existing system of guayines.
Otay Centenario borough was created by merging Mesa de Otay and Centenario.
A state contract was approved for an interurban rail line design and construction.
Statista data reported Tijuana as having the second highest homicide rate.
